exposure: computed tomography (CT) findings (proximal dilatation, distal collapse, mesenteric edema, pneumatosis, free air, portal venous gas, whirl sign, U/C-shaped bowel configuration, fecalization)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of patients who underwent surgery for suspected closed-loop small bowel obstruction at two suburban teaching hospitals.
finding: A random forest model combining clinical factors (prior surgery, age, lactate) and imaging factors (whirl sign, fecalization, U/C-shaped bowel configuration) was effective in predicting closed-loop small bowel obstruction.
